semantics.provider: offline fixed scores and reference-token usage; no paid requests or model-quality conclusions
semantics.cold: fresh process, tokenizer and owned caches per sample; startup/fixture setup excluded; OS cache uncontrolled
semantics.warm: ordered searches share one engine; edits and movement apply to the frozen synthetic workload
semantics.continuation: 70 single-fragment files; first attempt scores 64, measured continuation scores the remaining six
semantics.interruptions: manual deadlines injected in preparation, planning, evaluation and selection; wall timings measure recovery work, not ten-millisecond SLA accuracy
semantics.cancellation: real setImmediate cancellation requested during first warm score lookup; delivery and return delays are separate
semantics.ping: real stdio MCP ping scheduled during first warm score lookup; latency includes event-loop scheduling and JSON transport
semantics.memory: sampled RSS at instrumented boundaries, not guaranteed process peak; inclusive stage durations overlap
semantics.percentiles: p50 is the median; p95 omitted below 20 samples; no uncertainty or live-provider latency claims
